# OpenAPI spec report

<!-- Generated by `composer generate` from generator/recorded-types.json and generator/config. Do not edit by hand. -->

Where the Productive API v2 and its OpenAPI spec disagree, found while generating a PHP SDK from the spec. Reads were recorded on 2026-11-02, and writes on 2026-10-25 to 2026-11-02, against a trial organization. Every entry says how to reproduce it; `{id}` stands for the ID of any record of the organization.

## Behaviour the spec does not describe

Found by hand while recording and generating: the recordings alone do not show them.

| Endpoint | Spec | API | Reproduce |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `POST /resource_requests/{id}/resolve` | Does not say how `bookings` are sent. | Each booking is a resource object (`{"type": "bookings", "attributes": {…}}`); a list of attributes answers 400 `json_format_invalid`. | POST with `bookings` as a list of attribute objects: 400. As resource objects: 200. |
| `POST /tasks`, `PATCH /tasks/{id}` | Documents `tag_list`. | Ignores it: the task answers `"tag_list": []`, and `GET /tags` stays empty. | POST or PATCH a task with `"tag_list": ["sdk-check"]` or `"tag_list": "sdk-check"`: 201 or 200 with an empty `tag_list`. |
| `POST /payments` | Does not say that the invoice must have been sent. | 422 `invoice_not_sent` for a finalized invoice without `sent_on`. | POST a payment on a finalized invoice that was never sent: 422. After setting `sent_on` on the invoice: 201. |
| `POST /revenue_distributions` | No request body, and nothing about the deal's distribution type. | 422 `invalid_revenue_distribution_type` on a deal of the `default` type, which every budget has. | POST `deal_id`, `start_on`, `end_on` and `amount_percent` for a budget: 422. For a deal made with `"revenue_distribution_type": "even"`: 201. |
| `PATCH /expenses/{id}/approve`, `PATCH /expenses/{id}/reject`, `PATCH /expenses/{id}/unreject` | Does not say what happens without an expense approval policy. | An expense is approved when it is made (approve: 409 `record_already_approved`), rejecting answers 200 and leaves it as it was, and unreject answers 409 `record_already_unrejected`. | Without an approval policy: POST an expense, then PATCH approve (409), unapprove (200), reject (200, `rejected` stays false), unreject (409). |
| `DELETE /contracts/{id}` | Documents the delete without conditions. | 409 `contract_not_destroyable` once the contract generated a budget. | POST a contract, POST `/contracts/{id}/generate`, then DELETE: 409. Without the generate: 204. |
| `POST /survey_responses` | Does not say that a survey takes no response by default. | 422 `submission_access_denied` while the survey's `submission_access` is `nobody`, its default. | POST a survey without `submission_access`, then a response: 422. With `"submission_access": "organization"`: 201. |
| `POST /approval_policies`, `PATCH /approval_statuses/{id}/approve` | Does not say that both need the approvals add-on. | Without it, the policy answers 409 `approval_addon_disabled`, the status 403 `access_denied`: the same gate, two statuses. | On a plan without the add-on: POST a policy (409), PATCH approve on an approval status (403). |
| `GET /reports/*` | Does not document the rate limit of the reports, nor its headers. | Ten requests per 30 seconds. The 429 carries `X-RateLimit-Limit: 10`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0` and `X-RateLimit-Reset` in seconds to wait, and errors with `limit` and `period` beside the standard members. | Eleven report reads in a burst: the eleventh at the latest answers 429. |

## Structure of the spec

Found by hand while recording and generating: the recordings alone do not show them.

| Endpoint | Spec | API | Reproduce |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 78 resources | The create and the update share one request body, and 54 of those bodies have a `required` list. | An update requires nothing, so the list is wrong for every update. | Compare `requestBody` of `POST /<resource>` and `PATCH /<resource>/{id}`: the same `$ref`. |
| 249 integer enums | Integer `enum`s without names for their values (`"enum": [1, 2]`). | Only the descriptions say what 1 and 2 mean, where they say it at all. | Search the spec for `"type": "integer"` with an `enum` and no `x-enum-varnames`. |
| Every operation | The order of parameters changes between downloads of the same spec. | Not an API difference, but every comparison of two downloads shows changes that are none. | Download the spec twice, a few days apart, and diff the `parameters` lists. |
